verdict.rationale: Ultrametric says it "runs no model" and that work uses the customer's own AI plan, and some adapter context stays local during retrieval. Both suggest Ultrametric itself is not a model-training party, but neither is an explicit no-training commitment for the hosted company records. Missing for 10: an explicit policy that user data is not used for AI training, an opt-out or control mechanism, data-usage terms covering the hosted records, and independent corroboration. [2026-10-14 re-judge parity audit (owner-product lane): partial 3 -> none 0, restoring both audits: "runs no model" is an architecture statement, not a no-training commitment for hosted company records, no data-use policy or opt-out exists, and every peer sits at none/na on the same class of silence. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
